SET LOCAL app.current_tenant = $json.tenantId;

SELECT m.direction, m.content, m.ai_generated
FROM messages m
JOIN conversations c ON m.conversation_id = c.id
WHERE c.tenant_id = $json.tenantId AND c.contact_ref = $json.contactRef AND c.channel = 'whatsapp_text'
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;

parameters.query:
SET LOCAL app.current_tenant = $json.tenantId;

WITH conv AS (
  SELECT id FROM conversations
  WHERE tenant_id = $json.tenantId AND contact_ref = $json.contactRef AND channel = 'whatsapp_text'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, tenant_id, direction, content, ai_generated, tokens_used, created_at)
SELECT conv.id, $json.tenantId, 'out', $json.response, true, $json.tokensUsed, NOW()
FROM conv;

INSERT INTO tenant_usage (tenant_id, channel, period, messages_in, messages_out, tokens_used, cost_estimate)
VALUES ($json.tenantId, 'whatsapp_text', date_trunc('month', NOW()), 1, 1, $json.tokensUsed,
  $json.tokensUsed * (SELECT rate FROM cost_rates WHERE provider = 'openrouter' AND unit = 'token' LIMIT 1))
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, channel, period) DO UPDATE SET
  messages_in = tenant_usage.messages_in + 1,
  messages_out = tenant_usage.messages_out + 1,
  tokens_used = tenant_usage.tokens_used + $json.tokensUsed,
  cost_estimate = tenant_usage.cost_estimate + ($json.tokensUsed * (SELECT rate FROM cost_rates WHERE provider = 'openrouter' AND unit = 'token' LIMIT 1));
